svg.title: Turn admission and locking, session side
svg.desc: A turn request passes the per-session arrival-order chain, ExecutionCoordinator.acquire and admitTurn (budget, session lock plus global cap, loop pre-check, rate-limit wait) before a turn id is reserved and turn_state.json records it. Settlement releases the lock; a surviving record is recovered at the next serving start.
svg.text: Turn admission and locking, session side
What happens to one session's turn before and after the harness runs it. The harness half is in control-protocol.md.

g.title: Every surface reaches TurnManager.startTurn or reserveTurn. TaskExecutor skips the per-session chain and calls ExecutionCoordinator.acquire plus reserveAdmittedTurn directly.
g.text: web chat, channel, cron, logical agent; task and workflow enter at 2

g.title: turn_manager.dart. _sessionReservations is a SessionMutationCoordinator, so a later request for the same session cannot overtake an earlier one during the session read, governance checks, lock or permit.
g.text: same-session reservations run through the chain,
then the session is read: provider, policy, surface

g.title: execution_coordinator.dart. Fail-fast task and workflow requests take their lane permit before admission; every other request is admitted first and then takes its permit.
g.text: lane: primary or provider worker; runs admission

g.title: TurnGovernanceEnforcer.checkBudget: BudgetExhaustedException under action block. Reads usage only, so it records nothing.
g.text: read-only daily budget, before the lock

g.title: Waits while the session is locked, then throws BusyTurnException(isSameSession: false) if activeCount >= maxParallel. A cap rejection has recorded nothing yet.
Records state, so it runs only after the cap admitted the attempt. LoopAction.abort throws LoopDetectedException.
g.text: chain depth, token velocity; records the start

g.title: Polls once a second while holding the cap slot. A throw from this step or the previous one releases the lock.
g.text: defers while the global turn rate is reached

g.title: worker_capacity_gate.dart, ExecutionCoordinator._acquirePrimary/_acquireWorker. No permit means BusyTurnException (provider capacity) and the admission is released.
g.text: WorkerCapacityGate permit (fail-fast task, workflow: before a)

g.title: turn_runner.dart _reserveTurnState. The set call is synchronous (secureWriteFileSync) although the call site is unawaited.
g.text: the crash marker is durable before execution starts

g.title: TurnRunner.executeTurn launches the turn; see control-protocol.md section 6 for the harness half.
turn_runner_execution_loop.dart finally block and ConversationService._observeOutcome. A failed or cancelled turn holds the remaining queue instead.
g.text: lease released; the conversation queue releases its next
queued item if the turn completed

g.title: concurrency/session_mutation_coordinator.dart. One instance is one chain; nesting on the same instance and session deadlocks. The task executor is outside this chain.
g.text: spans session read, governance, lock and permit

g.title: concurrency/session_lock_manager.dart. One instance shared by every runner. Reconfigurable on server.*; a raise wakes callers parked in whenCapacityAvailable().
g.text: one lock per session; activeCount <= maxParallel
waiters resume in arrival order; 30 s warn, 120 s stuck

g.title: What each surface does when admission is refused for global capacity. Capacity wakeups reserve nothing; the retry may lose the race and wait again.
g.text: web chat: submission returns to queued, redispatched on capacity
channel: _untilAdmitted waits for capacity, then retries
task, workflow: fail-fast, retried on the next poll
same session busy: waits at the lock, not an error

g.title: TurnStateStore in dartclaw_core storage. Mutations are synchronous atomic writes; open quarantines malformed JSON.
g.text: { sessionId: { turnId, startedAt } }, one record per active turn

g.title: service_wiring.dart calls it after wiring when not headless; web_routes.dart renders the banner.
g.text: consumeRecoveryNotice: web page shows the banner once

svg.text: Opened directly in a browser, hovering a node shows its detail and highlights its outgoing edges.
